security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives from Markdown code fences and reference links, not executable Ruby shell calls. The three Python scripts do perform user-directed file writes through --output, which can overwrite files if used carelessly. No prompt injection or data exfiltration intent was found in the reviewed files.

remediation.suggestion: Check whether the output path exists and require confirmation before overwriting files. Restrict default writes to the current project directory.
Label install, Docker, Kubernetes, and environment setup commands as examples. Require user confirmation before any command is executed.
Use a safer setup note that checks for an existing .env file before creating one from .env.example.

content.value_statement: Complex projects need clear architecture decisions and documented trade-offs. This skill helps compare patterns, analyze dependencies, and produce structured recommendations for engineering teams.
actual_capabilities: Documents architecture patterns, system design workflows, and technology decision guidance.
Provides Python scripts for project architecture analysis, dependency analysis, and diagram report scaffolding.
Validates a target path before running each helper script.
Prints a basic report with target, status, and finding count.
Can emit JSON results to stdout or a user-specified output file.
limitations: The analyzer scripts are scaffolds and do not perform deep dependency inspection.
Output files can overwrite existing paths when the user supplies --output.
Reference documents contain generic placeholder examples, not detailed framework guidance.
It does not integrate with cloud providers, repositories, or monitoring systems.

use_cases.title: Plan a New Product Architecture
use_cases.description: Compare frontend, backend, data, and deployment choices before implementation starts.

use_cases.title: Review an Existing Codebase
use_cases.description: Run scaffolded analysis and organize architecture risks for a refactor planning session.

use_cases.title: Document Technical Decisions
use_cases.description: Turn trade-offs, constraints, and selected patterns into readable architecture notes.

prompt_templates.title: Begin Architecture Review
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review of a project structure.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this project as a senior architect. Identify the main components, risks, and missing architecture documentation.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Technology Options
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare these technology options for our constraints. Cover scalability, developer experience, cost, security, and migration risk.

prompt_templates.title: Create Decision Notes
prompt_templates.prompt: Create architecture decision notes for this proposal. Include context, options, decision, trade-offs, risks, and review triggers.

prompt_templates.title: Audit System Evolution
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze this system evolution plan. Find coupling risks, operational gaps, dependency concerns, and phased migration recommendations.

output_examples.input: Analyze a Next.js, Node.js, and PostgreSQL product architecture.
output: Architecture review covering frontend, backend, data layer, and deployment concerns.
Trade-off notes comparing REST, GraphQL, PostgreSQL, and managed services.
A short recommendation list with risks and follow-up questions.

output_examples.input: Prepare decision notes for choosing React Native or Flutter.
output: Decision summary with product constraints and team skill assumptions.
Comparison of delivery speed, platform behavior, hiring impact, and long-term maintenance.
Recommended option with review conditions and known risks.

output_examples.input: Review dependency and architecture risks before a refactor.
output: Target path validation and a basic analysis report.
Risk themes for coupling, test coverage, deployment impact, and missing documentation.
Actionable next steps for a focused refactor plan.

best_practices: Review generated recommendations against current system constraints before implementation.
Run scripts only on project paths you intend to analyze.
Confirm output paths before writing reports to disk.
anti_patterns: Do not run setup or deployment commands without user confirmation.
Do not treat placeholder reference examples as production-ready architecture.
Do not write output files into sensitive directories or configuration paths.

faq.question: Does this skill design complete production systems?
faq.answer: It supports architecture planning and documentation. Final production design still needs expert review and environment-specific validation.

faq.question: Can it analyze dependencies automatically?
faq.answer: It includes a dependency analyzer scaffold. The current script returns a basic report, not a full dependency graph.

faq.question: Does it create architecture diagrams?
faq.answer: It includes a diagram generator scaffold and documentation guidance. Diagram content depends on user-provided context and follow-up work.

faq.question: Is it compatible with Claude Code and Codex?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Will it modify my project files?
faq.answer: The scripts read a target path and can write JSON output only when you provide an output path.

faq.question: What teams benefit most from this skill?
faq.answer: Teams planning architecture changes, technology selections, refactors, or decision records benefit most from its structured prompts and references.
